post.caption:
Your innate immune response attacks anything that looks wrong and remembers nothing. Behind it the adaptive response builds an antibody shaped for one specific invader, which takes days, which is why you get ill the first time. Then it stores memory cells holding that shape for decades. Meet the same thing again and you never notice. That is exactly what a vaccine exploits: it is a training exercise, not a treatment.
